note: PlanRegistry is the original deployment and was deliberately kept: its code did not change and its five rules carry consensus digests that cost real validator rounds. Its clause_sections were re-seeded in place, because register_rule upserts and preserves those digests. OmbudsCourt and AdvancePool were redeployed: Verdict gained confidence_floor and clears_floor so the payout predicate is settled by the panel rather than recomputed against a mutable floor, and Underwriter gained loss_borne_atto so a write off is shared pro rata instead of falling on whoever withdraws last. Both are storage changes a live deployment cannot absorb in place. Every payout also moved from on=finalized to on=accepted, because finalized transfers were measured debiting a contract and never arriving.
